title: The Lexicon of Proto Oceanic
cite_as: Malcolm Ross, Andrew Pawley and Meredith Osmond (eds.) 1998-2016. The Lexicon of Proto Oceanic: The culture and environment of ancestral Oceanic society, vols. 1-6. Canberra: Pacific Linguistics and Asia-Pacific Linguistics; CLDF dataset v0.1.1, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23688418.
kind_of_work: thematic comparative dictionary of Proto Oceanic in six volumes (67 chapters by several authors), as a CLDF Wordlist (lexibank, pyetymdict tables)
holder: Ross, Pawley and Osmond as editors; each chapter's authors (chapters.csv); the CLDF conversion is by Forkel
glottolog: The release maps its languages with Glottolog v5.3, as wety's catalogs do.

curation.language_map: etc/languages.json (from etc/languages.reviewed.json and the catalog bundle)
curation.tree: etc/tree.json (from etc/tree.reviewed.json: the levels above Oceanic and where non-Oceanic languages hang)
